text: CLI probe and BadInput tests: missing, directory, malformed JSON, wrong-type rows, no or two entrances, unknown char, unknown id, empty list, binary list, unreachable, wall cell. Each one exit 2, one error line, no traceback.
bench --seeds 0 gave ZeroDivisionError traceback; --step-s -1 gave negative times; gen --list-size 0 wrote an empty list
argument checks added in routeopt.py; regression tests in test_routeopt.BadArguments
Collision tests: two products on one cell both picked; repeated list lines counted twice; duplicate product id on map is unusable when requested
BadInput.test_unrequested_broken_entry_is_skipped_with_warning: unrequested out-of-map and duplicate entries warn and skip; requested broken entries still exit 2
Simulate.test_cli_trace_recount_matches_kpis: recount() in the test reads CLI step/pick lines and raw rows, separate from routeopt code; Compare test recomputes the saving formula

Quantifiers: 4 layout families x 25 seeds; 80x60 families x 5 seeds (20 stores, all valid); 300x300 store with 1000 products and 60 items (7.5 s); corridor, one-cell map, all-wall map, 1x1 map with products on entrance
Scale probe, outside the suite: 500x500 aisles with 1000 products and 100 items took 31 s; 500x500 random took 35 s. Both valid routes.
2-opt route is not always optimal: vs brute force on 40 aisle stores with 7 items, exact in 37, worst gap 13.2% longer
2-opt gap: worst case 13% longer than optimum on 7-item lists; not provably optimal
scale: 500x500 with 100 items takes about 31 to 35 s, not in any check; run time grows with map cells times items
30% claim is measured against random list orders on generated aisle stores; no real store data
